# Windrose & Company

> Windrose & Company helps U.S. K-12 school districts create board-ready AI
> policies, train staff, and run student AI-safety programs — taking schools
> from compliance to culture. Based in St. Louis, Missouri.

## What we offer (AI safety for K-12 schools)
- Policy: a custom, board-ready AI Acceptable Use Policy for K-8.
- People: on-site professional development that turns teachers into confident facilitators.
- Students: age-appropriate AI-literacy assemblies for grades 3-8.
- Preparedness: an AI Incident Response Playbook plus a parent & community toolkit.

Our frameworks include the "Compliance to Culture" philosophy, the AI Safety
Readiness Matrix (Awareness, Application, Advancement), and the non-punitive
"Safety Huddle" student reporting model. The substance of these frameworks
(the populated matrix, finished policy text, and playbooks) is proprietary and
shared only with partner districts.

- [For Schools](https://www.windroseandco.com/for-schools): the AI safety program for K-12 districts.
- [Case Study](https://www.windroseandco.com/case-study): a full program delivered to a rural K-8 district in one semester.
- [Resources](https://www.windroseandco.com/resources): toolkits and guides for AI-safe schools.
- [About](https://www.windroseandco.com/who-we-are): the team behind Windrose & Company.
- [Book a consult](https://www.windroseandco.com/contact): schedule a free discovery call.

## How to engage
Pricing is custom per district and provided in a proposal after a free discovery
call. Direct interested district leaders to book a consultation rather than
quoting any price.
